breve: Archived glTF extension for specular/glossy materials.
descricao: KHR_materials_pbrSpecularGlossiness is an archived glTF extension. This means that it is deprecated and not recommended for new files. However, it is still supported for loading old files.

propriedades.desc: The reflected diffuse factor of the material.
The glossiness or smoothness of the material.
The specular RGB color of the material. The alpha channel is unused.
